papers.title: Deep learning for EEG-based Motor Imagery classification: Accuracy-cost trade-off

protocol.dataset_and_task: Three selected University of Essex participants (104, 107, 110) from a 12-person study; left hand, right hand and feet imagery. Fifteen channels, 256 Hz, 178 patterns and 3,600 wavelet-derived input features per participant dataset.
protocol.evaluation: Participant-specific experiments; 5-fold training-set cross-validation guides genetic feature/structure/training-hyperparameter searches, and test-set Kappa evaluates final models. Results average 15 executions. No held-out-person or external-dataset test is reported.
protocol.target_label_budget: Labels from each evaluated participant enter that participant dataset’s fitting/selection; this is not unseen-target source-only evaluation.
protocol.target_unlabelled_statistics_budget: Patterns are normalized to [0,1]; fitted normalization scope is not sufficiently specified to certify a source-only contract. No source–target adaptation protocol is reported.
protocol.selection_and_features: Genetic feature selection and two-stage structural/learning search, including epochs; wavelet variance features and shallow CNN/FFNN/RNN.
protocol.metrics_and_compute: Training CV accuracy; test Kappa; measured training energy/time and architecture complexity.
protocol.relevance: Useful for a narrow statement that model selection and compute belong in evaluation. Low priority for main related work: selected-participant, within-dataset experiment differs substantially from this frozen external audit. Do not use as a numerical baseline.

papers.title: SMMTM: Motor imagery EEG decoding algorithm using a hybrid multi-branch separable convolutional self-attention temporal convolutional network

protocol.dataset_and_task: BCI Competition IV-2a (nine participants, four classes, 22 channels) and IV-2b (nine participants, binary hands, three channels), sampled at 250 Hz.
protocol.evaluation: Within-person evaluation and IV-2a LOSO: one held-out person and eight training people. It describes 5-fold validation and validation-set parameter selection/early stopping, but does not fully identify validation folds or every selection information boundary. Do not infer target-label leakage.
protocol.target_label_budget: LOSO testing labels support evaluation; remaining-person labels support training. Exact hyperparameter/early-stopping validation partition is not sufficiently documented to certify equivalence to the present source-only contract.
protocol.target_unlabelled_statistics_budget: Z-score mean/variance are explicitly fitted on training data and applied to test data. No target distribution-matching procedure is reported.
protocol.selection_and_features: Serial spatiotemporal convolutions; three learned separable-convolution branches with kernel lengths 8/16/32; self-attention, TCN and feature/decision fusion. These are learned multiscale temporal filters, not fixed mu/beta input views.
protocol.metrics_and_compute: Accuracy, Kappa and Wilcoxon comparisons; architecture complexity is documented.
protocol.relevance: Direct recent architectural context, but no external-cohort replication or matched frozen source-selection protocol. A concise citation is justified; no SOTA ranking or isolated spectral-sharing comparison.

papers.title: RMETNet: A cross-subject motor imagery EEG signal classification model based on TSLANet and riemannian geometry features

protocol.dataset_and_task: IV-2a (nine people, four classes, 22 channels) and IV-2b (nine people, binary hands, three channels; only three feedback sessions, 480 trials/person). Four-second 0.5–4.5-s post-cue windows.
protocol.evaluation: LOSO and within-person 8:1:1 splits; source participants supply training/validation. Source–target MMD and precomputed Riemannian alignment are expressly part of the method, which the paper calls session-level adaptation.
protocol.target_label_budget: Classification weighting uses source labels. Unlabelled target features enter distribution matching; no explicit ground-truth target supervision is described for MMD. Detailed target sample exposure/timing is not fully resolved; do not assume all-label access or source-only equivalence.
protocol.target_unlabelled_statistics_budget: Training-fitted Z-score parameters; covariance/Riemannian features from source and target plus MMD alignment. This uses target distribution information, unlike the present no-target-adaptation contract.
protocol.selection_and_features: 500-epoch training budget; minimum-validation-loss checkpoint. TSLANet learned spectral gating, spatiotemporal convolutions and Riemannian branch.
protocol.metrics_and_compute: Accuracy, Kappa, Wilcoxon; parameters, FLOPs and latency with preprocessing distinguished from forward inference.
protocol.relevance: Highly relevant to distinguish cross-person transfer with unlabelled adaptation from strictly frozen source-only external evaluation. Cite for protocol distinction, not as a matched superiority comparator.

recommendation.main_related_work: Use SMMTM and RMETNet only if the revision needs recent architecture/adaptation context. They do not establish superiority, equivalence or a matched comparator for the present source-only pipeline audit. The 2020 accuracy-cost study is optional and lower priority; omit if the manuscript already supports compute/selection limitations.
recommendation.candidate_prose: Recent multibranch architectures combine temporal convolutions and attention for within-dataset motor-imagery decoding, as in SMMTM. RMETNet adds learned spectral and Riemannian features together with source–target distribution alignment. These architecture and adaptation studies address a different evaluation question from the present audit of frozen source-selected external pipelines; their published accuracies do not provide matched estimates for our contrasts.
